title: init commits the whole git index and configures a sync remote
description: issuegraph init created a git commit containing all staged changes and set sync.remote plus a Dolt origin from the git remote. Both contradict the local-only goal. Commit only its own files and never auto-configure a remote.

title: RFC 0003: remove Dolt remote sync
description: Remove issuegraph dolt push/pull and remote config. Note: issuegraph init currently auto-configures sync.remote and a Dolt origin remote from the git origin; this must stop.

title: RFC 0019: confirm shipify can build and sign without repo scripts
description: Open items: Linux/Windows CGO build, Windows Authenticode signing, ICU linkage check, PE metadata, contract-corpus artifact. Signing and winres scripts were deleted; Windows releases may ship unsigned.

title: RFC 0016: shennong-bucket manifest (Windows)
description: Draft RFC. Approve, then add bucket/issuegraph.json (amd64 and arm64 zips) via shipify PR to systembugtj/shennong-bucket.

title: RFC 0015: cangjie-nix package (Linux)
description: Draft RFC. Approve, then add nix/issuegraph.nix (autoPatchelfHook, x86_64/aarch64) via shipify PR to systembugtj/cangjie-nix.

title: RFC 0012: land luban-homebrew formula (macOS)
description: Open the issuegraph formula PR in systembugtj/luban-homebrew via shipify after release assets are public. Blocks docs naming the brew command.

title: RFC 0001: IssueGraph local-first restructure
description: Umbrella for the rebrand and local-first work. Close when every child RFC is Implemented. See .spec/ROADMAP.md.

title: modules/core/scripts tests cannot find .github
description: Tests resolve .github relative to the module root (modules/core) after the layout move, so they fail. Fix repo-root discovery.

title: RFC 0008: disable external tracker network sync
description: Depends on 0003. Disable ado, github, gitlab, jira, linear style sync.

title: RFC 0004: Git-tracked snapshot
description: Complete local snapshot (.issuegraph/issues.jsonl + manifest) tracked by Git. Must land before 0003.
notes: Implemented: snapshot manifest (sha256, id set), default-on snapshot after every write, snapshot restore, tests. Remaining: full-suite regression check, advance RFC.

title: RFC 0018: port MCP server to Go as issuegraph mcp
description: Draft RFC. Approve, capture golden tool schemas from the Python server, port ~38 tools, then delete integrations/issuegraph-mcp.

title: RFC 0017: close out shipify-channels-only
description: Code and docs done. Advance to Implemented and archive once 0012, 0015 and 0016 channel PRs are merged.

title: RFC 0010: finish asset layout migration
description: plugins/issuegraph moved to issuegraph/. Verify no stale references remain and generated Go assets are reproducible.

title: Reconcile RFC 0006 and 0009 with 0013 layout
description: 0006 still puts the npm app in apps/cli and 0009 still puts the CLI in modules/cli. Update or archive them.

title: RFC 0007: repo-native git hooks
description: Use .githooks and core.hooksPath for local checks only.
